title: Release-notes contributor list from git: co-author trailers, mailmap, ranges
prompt: Rewrite tools/contributors.sh (bash) to list the people to thank for a revision range: the first argument, default HEAD. Print one line per person, `<commits><TAB><Name> <email>`, sorted by commit count (highest first) and then by name. A commit credits its author and everyone named in its Co-authored-by: trailers, each person once per commit. Apply the repository's .mailmap to authors and co-authors alike, treat emails case-insensitively (print them in lowercase; when the names differ, use the name from the newest commit), and skip merge commits. It must also work when run from a subdirectory of the repository. Document the script in the README. Run the tests when you are done.
notes: Added 2026-11-27 for the crawl on/off A/B (knowledge corpus) as the weak-crawl control: crawl_code_bash only has loosely related release scripts (nearest ~0.36) and no git-scm docs yet. Traps: %aN/%aE (mailmap), %(trailers:key=Co-authored-by,valueonly) instead of grepping the message (a 'Co-authored-by:' mid-body line is not a trailer), case-insensitive trailer key, git check-mailmap for co-authors, --no-merges (the merge carries a trailer), once per commit, range argument. Runs with msys2 bash + git from C:\devkitPro.
